steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.6 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts; absent artifact after restore causes exit 1) and add enforcing test names (resume-rehydrate-test.sh, resume-entry-points-test.sh) inline; step 3.5 covers cycle_iterations amendment — use 3.6 to avoid collision
Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs)
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); body identical to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh _hydrate_put_back call site to _artifact_persist_put_back (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)
Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: redirect the direct _hydrate_put_back call at line 216 to _artifact_persist_put_back

Fix _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: guard the current_iter read with [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]]; when not in resume mode, use _start_iter=1 unconditionally (restoring old behaviour for fresh runs and nested-loop re-entries)

In runner.sh, after the _runner_resume_rehydrate call at the resume entry point, export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true (before the dispatch loop) so cycle orchestrators know they are in resume context; do NOT set it for fresh runs

Confirm tests/integration/cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh, and tests/integration/cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh pass after the guard fix (they were broken by the unconditional current_iter read)

Update tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh: add export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true before the cycle_orchestrator_run call (the test calls the orchestrator directly, bypassing runner.sh; without this the guard prevents reading current_iter and SPEC-7 "first dispatched iter is 2" fails); replace the "no iter=1 complete" zero-count assertion with wc -l | tr -d ' ' instead of grep -c || echo 0 (the latter produces "0\n0" when count=0)

Update tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh: (1) fix all three SPEC-1 zero-count assertions ("intake emits no stage.start") to use wc -l | tr -d ' ' instead of grep -c '^...$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0; (2) add --no-resume flag to the SPEC-12 runner invocation to prevent auto-resume (status=in_progress + recent timestamp triggers auto_resume); (3) remove the cycled-dispatch assertion for SPEC-12 (cycled does not dispatch in full runner runs) and replace with intake-dispatched + type:cycle fixture content check; (4) remove any [#1805/SPEC-13]-tagged assertions entirely — SPEC-13 is dropped
Update tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: fix the SPEC-3 "intake emits no stage.start" zero-count assertion to use wc -l | tr -d ' ' instead of grep -c || echo 0

Update tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: remove any [#1805/SPEC-13]-tagged cycled-dispatch assertion (SPEC-13 is dropped; no requirement mandates that cycled dispatches in full runner runs); the intake-dispatched assertion and type:cycle content check may remain if tagged under a valid SPEC or untagged

Update tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: pre-write intake's primary artifact to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run so SPEC-2 fail-closed path does not break the existing exit-0 assertion

Update tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: ensure the Phase 1 intake stub writes intake-result.json; if the stub from mock_plugin_factory does not write it, replace with a stub that does; confirm P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
